title: Candidate size threshold equivalence
statement: Let $w$ be a positive natural number and let $k$ be a natural number. The inequality $1-(1-2^{-w})^k\le 1/2$ holds if and only if $k\le \frac{\log 2}{-\log(1-2^{-w})}$.
